# Indigenous Hands and Voices

> A comprehensive initiative dedicated to documenting, preserving, and revitalizing endangered indigenous languages and cultural heritage through digital tools, community engagement, and educational programs.

Indigenous Hands and Voices (IHAV) operates multiple language documentation and preservation projects across Africa and North America, with a focus on endangered languages like Igbo and Tiv in Nigeria, as well as indigenous sign languages and literacy initiatives in New Mexico. The organization combines linguistic research with community-driven education and digital archiving to ensure indigenous knowledge systems are preserved for future generations.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous languages
- Language documentation
- Language preservation
- Endangered languages

## Flagship Language Documentation Projects

- [Indigenous Spoken Language Documentation Project (ISLDP2)](https://i-hav.org/portfolio/indigenous-spoken-language-documentation-project-isldp2): ISLDP2: Main project documenting endangered indigenous languages including Igbo and Tiv
- [Indigenous Sign Language Documentation Project](https://i-hav.org/portfolio/indigenous-sign-language-documentation-project): Documentation project for Nigerian sign languages and deaf community empowerment

## Language-Specific Preservation Initiatives

- [The Igbo Literacy Project](https://i-hav.org/portfolio/indigenous-spoken-language-documentation-project-isldp2/the-igbo-literacy-project): Igbo language preservation and literacy via Omenka App digital archive platform
- [Tiv Language Project](https://i-hav.org/portfolio/indigenous-spoken-language-documentation-project-isldp2/tiv-language-project): Tiv language documentation and preservation through digital tools and literacy programs

## Community Engagement & Cultural Events

- [Indigenous Hands and Voices Literacy Festival (IHAVLiFest)](https://i-hav.org/portfolio/indigenous-hands-and-voices-literacy-festival-ihavlifest): IHAVLiFest: Indigenous literacy festival in New Mexico promoting language and cultural heritage
